[SWS_DM_00909] Support of Subfunction 0x01 (ON)
⌈
If the Diagnos-
tic Server instance receives a valid UDS service ControlDTCSetting (0x85) with
Subfunction 0x01 (ON) and optionally with DTCSettingControlOptionRecord of value
0xFFFFFF, the Diagnostic Server instance shall:
• enable the update of the UDS DTC status byte
• enable the storage in event memory
• update
diag::DTCInformation::ControlDtcStatusType
([SWS_DM_00663]) to kDTCSettingOn
⌋
